integrity: A complete analytical proof and an exact rational finite checker are included; finite checks do not replace proof. Self-review only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: General John criterion is classical input; factor John normalizations are required for the block covariance display, and no enclosing Löwner ellipsoid is determined. Older equivalent bibliography remains possible.
title: A universal John ellipsoid and complete contact transfer law for affine free joins
